cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Conduct literature research for the development of study protocols and analyses. Assist with maintaining and filing appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies. Assist in the development of all study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies with senior staff. Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study. Be held accountable for understanding and completing all protocol requirements. Review weekly research articles as a part of an ongoing discussion group regarding directions in clinical research with a focus on pain. Informed consent regulations. Completion of required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training. Consent form preparation, processing and revisions. Adherence to consent throughout study. Correct communication of protocol and research procedures to subject and significant others. Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly. Communicate with other departments as needed to coordinate and conduct elements of research protocol. Accurately answer questions presented by participants, or refer them to proper person/resource. Identify, recruit and enroll patients in clinical studies. Assist participants with computer enrollment software/process. Abstract charts with attention to detail. Be responsible for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability. Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion. Communicate all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely and efficient manner to ensure subject care and safety. Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other appropriate information in required detail. Monitor subject accrual and quality assurance. Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times. Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project. Database creating and management including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during study, and ensuring data integrity. Assist with analysis of collected data and creation of resulting manuscripts and posters. Prepare annual report and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide update information regarding continuing studies. Provide update reports to study sponsors at required intervals.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (preferably in social, biological, computer or healthcare sciences)
6 Months minimum experience as a research assistant in human subjects' research (or equivalent position)
Preferred Requirements
Experience facilitating recruitment and follow-up strategies with clinic personnel and operational problem solving
Skills with Microsoft Office, coding, data analysis, copy machines, fax machines, bladder scanners, EEG equipment

cond_0151.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0151.responsibilities:
Conduct literature research for the development of study protocols and analyses.
Assist with maintaining and filing appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies.
Assist in the development of all study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies with senior staff.
Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study.
Be held accountable for understanding and completing all protocol requirements.
Review weekly research articles as part of an ongoing discussion group on directions in clinical research with a focus on pain.
Complete required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training.
Prepare, process, and revise consent forms in line with informed consent regulations.
Ensure adherence to consent throughout the study.
Convey protocol and research procedures accurately to subjects and their significant others.
Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly.
Interface with other departments as needed to coordinate elements of the research protocol.
Answer questions from participants accurately, or refer them to the appropriate person or resource.
Identify, recruit, and enroll patients in clinical studies.
Assist participants with computer enrollment software and processes.
Abstract charts with attention to detail.
Administer study treatments accurately per protocols and maintain drug accountability.
Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion.
Report all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely manner to support subject care and safety.
Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other required information in the necessary detail.
Monitor subject accrual and quality assurance.
Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times.
Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project.
Create and manage databases, including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during the study, and ensuring data integrity.
Assist with analysis of collected data and preparation of resulting manuscripts and posters.
Prepare annual reports and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide updates on continuing studies.
Submit update reports to study sponsors at required intervals.
cond_0151.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in social, biological, computer, or healthcare sciences
At least 6 months of experience as a research assistant in human subjects research, or equivalent position
Preferred Requirements
Experience supporting recruitment and follow-up strategies with clinic personnel and operational problem solving
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, coding, data analysis, copy machines, fax machines, bladder scanners, and EEG equipment

cond_0252.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Coordinate literature research to support the development of study protocols and analyses.
Work with senior staff to help maintain and file appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies.
Collaborate on the development of study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies.
Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study.
Share accountability for understanding and completing all protocol requirements.
Participate in a weekly research article discussion group focused on directions in clinical research with an emphasis on pain.
Support informed consent processes including form preparation, processing, and revisions.
Complete required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training.
Help ensure adherence to consent throughout the study.
Coordinate clear communication of protocol and research procedures to participants and significant others.
Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly.
Work with other departments as needed to coordinate and carry out elements of the research protocol.
Accurately answer questions from participants, or refer them to the appropriate person or resource.
Help identify, recruit, and enroll patients in clinical studies.
Assist participants with computer enrollment software and processes.
Abstract charts with attention to detail.
Share responsibility for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability.
Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion.
Communicate all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely manner to support subject care and safety.
Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other appropriate information in required detail.
Support monitoring of subject accrual and quality assurance.
Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times.
Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project.
Coordinate database creation and management including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during the study, and ensuring data integrity.
Assist with analysis of collected data and contribute to the creation of resulting manuscripts and posters.
Prepare annual reports and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide updates on continuing studies.
Share update reports with study sponsors at required intervals.

cond_0272.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0272.responsibilities: Conduct literature research for the development of study protocols and analyses. Assist with maintaining and filing appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies. Assist in the development of all study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies with senior staff. Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study. Be held accountable for understanding and completing all protocol requirements. Review weekly research articles as a part of an ongoing discussion group regarding directions in clinical research with a focus on pain. Informed consent regulations. Completion of required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training. Consent form preparation, processing and revisions. Adherence to consent throughout study. Correct communication of protocol and research procedures to subject and significant others. Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly. Communicate with other departments as needed to coordinate and conduct elements of research protocol. Accurately answer questions presented by participants, or refer them to proper person/resource. Identify, recruit and enroll patients in clinical studies. Assist participants with computer enrollment software/process. Abstract charts with attention to detail. Be responsible for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability. Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion. Communicate all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely and efficient manner to ensure subject care and safety. Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other appropriate information in required detail. Monitor subject accrual and quality assurance. Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times. Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project. Database creating and management including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during study, and ensuring data integrity. Assist with analysis of collected data and creation of resulting manuscripts and posters. Prepare annual report and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide update information regarding continuing studies. Provide update reports to study sponsors at required intervals.
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in social, biological, computer, or healthcare sciences required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 6 months of demonstrated expertise as a research assistant in human subjects research (or equivalent position).
Deep knowledge of Microsoft Office, coding, and data analysis tools.
Preferred Requirements
Proven track record in facilitating recruitment and follow-up strategies with clinic personnel and operational problem solving.
Proficiency with office and clinical equipment including copy machines, fax machines, bladder scanners, and EEG equipment.

cond_0442.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0442.responsibilities: Conduct literature research for the development of study protocols and analyses. Assist with maintaining and filing appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies. Assist in the development of all study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies with senior staff. Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study. Be held accountable for understanding and completing all protocol requirements. Review weekly research articles as a part of an ongoing discussion group regarding directions in clinical research with a focus on pain. Informed consent regulations. Completion of required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training. Consent form preparation, processing and revisions. Adherence to consent throughout study. Correct communication of protocol and research procedures to subject and significant others. Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly. Communicate with other departments as needed to coordinate and conduct elements of research protocol. Accurately answer questions presented by participants, or refer them to proper person/resource. Identify, recruit and enroll patients in clinical studies. Assist participants with computer enrollment software/process. Abstract charts with attention to detail. Be responsible for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability. Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion. Communicate all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely and efficient manner to ensure subject care and safety. Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other appropriate information in required detail. Monitor subject accrual and quality assurance. Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times. Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project. Database creating and management including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during study, and ensuring data integrity. Assist with analysis of collected data and creation of resulting manuscripts and posters. Prepare annual report and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide update information regarding continuing studies. Provide update reports to study sponsors at required intervals.
cond_0442.requirements:
Bachelor's degree (preferably in social, biological, computer or healthcare sciences) required
6 Months minimum experience as a research assistant in human subjects' research (or equivalent position) required
Experience facilitating recruitment and follow-up strategies with clinic personnel and operational problem solving
Skills with Microsoft Office, coding, data analysis, copy machines, fax machines, bladder scanners, EEG equipment

cond_0463.responsibilities: Conduct literature research for the development of study protocols and analyses. Assist with maintaining and filing appropriate documentation with IRB and grant making agencies. Assist in the development of all study forms, necessary database programs and data collection/entry strategies with senior staff. Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study. Be held accountable for understanding and completing all protocol requirements. Review weekly research articles as a part of an ongoing discussion group regarding directions in clinical research with a focus on pain. Informed consent regulations. Completion of required NIH training and [Company name masked] research training. Consent form preparation, processing and revisions. Adherence to consent throughout study. Correct communication of protocol and research procedures to subject and significant others. Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedule accordingly. Communicate with other departments as needed to coordinate and conduct elements of research protocol. Accurately answer questions presented by participants, or refer them to proper person/resource. Identify, recruit and enroll patients in clinical studies. Assist participants with computer enrollment software/process. Abstract charts with attention to detail. Be responsible for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability. Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion. Communicate all study/protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely and efficient manner to ensure subject care and safety. Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other appropriate information in required detail. Monitor subject accrual and quality assurance. Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times. Maintain accurate and organized documentation for each project. Database creating and management including safekeeping files, entering data gathered during study, and ensuring data integrity. Assist with analysis of collected data and creation of resulting manuscripts and posters. Prepare annual report and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide update information regarding continuing studies. Provide update reports to study sponsors at required intervals.

Bachelor's degree (preferably in social, biological, computer or healthcare sciences)
6 Months minimum experience as a research assistant in human subjects' research (or equivalent position)
Preferred Requirements
Experience facilitating recruitment and follow-up strategies with clinic personnel and operational problem solving
Skills with Microsoft Office, coding, data analysis, copy machines, fax machines, bladder scanners, EEG equipment

cond_0639.intro: We are looking for a Research Assistant to join our team.
cond_0639.responsibilities:
Coordinate literature research to support the development of study protocols and analyses.
Work with senior staff to help develop study forms, database programs, and data collection and entry strategies.
Assist with maintaining and filing documentation with IRB and grant-making agencies.
Read and understand the protocol and any other pertinent information for each scheduled study.
Share accountability for understanding and completing all protocol requirements.
Participate in a weekly research article discussion group focused on directions in clinical research with an emphasis on pain.
Support informed consent processes, including form preparation, processing, and revisions.
Help ensure adherence to consent throughout the study.
Communicate protocol and research procedures clearly to participants and their significant others.
Coordinate study requirements with other research personnel and adjust work schedules accordingly.
Work with other departments as needed to coordinate and carry out elements of the research protocol.
Accurately answer questions from participants, or refer them to the appropriate person or resource.
Help identify, recruit, and enroll patients in clinical studies.
Assist participants with computer enrollment software and processes.
Abstract charts with attention to detail.
Share responsibility for accurate study treatment administration per protocols and drug accountability.
Monitor and evaluate clinical parameters and document appropriately for safety and protocol completion.
Communicate all study and protocol deviations and adverse events to the PI or MD in a timely manner to support subject care and safety.
Document adverse events, subject care, subject behavior, and other relevant information in required detail.
Support subject accrual monitoring and quality assurance.
Maintain subject and sponsor confidentiality at all times.
Keep accurate and organized documentation for each project.
Assist with database creation and management, including safekeeping files, entering study data, and ensuring data integrity.
Collaborate on analysis of collected data and contribute to resulting manuscripts and posters.
Prepare annual reports and submit to the IRB as directed by the PI to renew consent forms and provide updates on continuing studies.
Share update reports with study sponsors at required intervals.
